question: What is the seven-syllable mantra beginning with Mahāhāṭaka and Īśvarī that destroys sin?
premises: The seven-syllable formula begins with Mahāhāṭaka and Īśvarī.
It is addressed with the word forgive.
It has three syllables and destroys sin.
inference: This addressed seven-syllable goddess mantra includes a three-syllable forgive formula and destroys sin.
uncertainties: mahāhāṭakaśabda may be a bīja or a name.
The placement of the three syllables is not stated.
plain_english: The seven-syllable formula beginning with Mahāhāṭaka and Īśvarī is addressed with forgive; it has three syllables and destroys sin.
